Reviewed 2026-08-31. Run only 01 token fetch, then 02 business POST. No MIGO verification GET.

Historical evidence: delivery 9004953174 created from STO 5600084209/000010. Use a newly approved eligible case.

Original collections and diagnostic evidence are preserved in the neighboring original folder. Revised scripts have offline tests only; no new SAP posting has been run.

Standard SAP repeatability requested using RequestID and RepeatabilityCreation HTTP headers. The local guard is NOT server-side protection. DS4/200 setup completed on 2026-08-31; QS4/700 setup and live posting replay/concurrency proof remain pending. These four files use QS4 environments.

Select the matching Reviewed environment. Fill an approved test case, use a stable submissionId, and set the confirmation to YES only immediately before a deliberate posting. Never clear local history to resolve an uncertain outcome.

Use trusted HTTPS and keep cookies enabled. Do not share populated passwords, tokens, cookies or local submission history.

request.description:
REAL SAP WRITE. Use an approved fresh test case; the historical example has already posted.

Use the approved STO predecessor and delivery quantity. POST success returns DeliveryDocument. Trade and Non-trade remain outside this STO proof.

Set submissionId to a unique GUID ONCE per business submission, fill all inputs, fetch the token, then set confirmCreateDI=YES. The script consumes YES before dispatch. The GUID is sent as the standard SAP RequestID HEADER, not an entity property.

Local history skips previously attempted submissions in this environment. Skipping produces no new HTTP response; inspect the Postman Console and saved result.

Requires configured SAP Gateway idempotent services. On 2026-08-31 DS4/200 was initialized and both switch jobs were released (6h document / 12h request-ID intervals). QS4/700 remains unconfigured; these environments target QS4. Live posting replay/concurrency proof is outstanding. Never remove these headers to bypass a 412 or missing-configuration error.

The local guard is NOT atomic across runtimes. Backend protection depends on SAP configuration and its finite retention window. Only RepeatabilityResult=supported plus a valid POST document result passes verification.

For deliberate sequential QA replay only: after Basis confirms retention, set verifiedReplayWindowSeconds (1-300). Inside that window after verified success, keep ALL inputs and submissionId unchanged, set confirmRepeatSameSubmission=YES and confirmCreateDI=YES. This sends the same POST, not a GET, and requires the original document key. Do not use QA replay for uncertain/failed/expired attempts.
